directives.title: Free Will Invariant
directives.statement: No automation may override human consent; SAFE_MODE routines can only restore lower balance states.

directives.title: Child Safety Covenant
directives.statement: Child-centered data streams must pass through Auris safeguards and remain anonymized at rest.

directives.title: Transparency Ledger
directives.statement: All irreversible transitions require a chronicle entry and guardian digest with timestamp proof.

directives.title: Non-Weaponization
directives.statement: Telemetry, symbolic compilers, and tensor exports cannot be repurposed for offensive capabilities.
